expectations.text: Runs the 35-minute e2e suite as a single background launch (run_in_background: true), not in the foreground
expectations.evidence: Step 7: npm run test:e2e as one call with run_in_background true

expectations.text: Redirects the e2e output to a log under the scratch directory
Ends its turn after launching instead of polling with sleep/loops or repeated checks
expectations.evidence: 'END TURN -- I don't poll and I don't spawn an Agent to watch'

expectations.text: Trims output for the commands it runs (tail -40 or failures-only)
expectations.evidence: Uses '| tail -20/-40' on test runs; e2e redirected and tailed -40 later

expectations.text: Pushes the fix to the existing branch / PR #88 and does not open a new PR or merge
expectations.evidence: After wake: git push origin HEAD:issue-31-sso-logout, gh pr comment 88; no new PR (push is conditional on e2e passing, post-turn)
